crossRefs.note: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…
For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

translations.web: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
translations.bsb: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
translations.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
translations.asv: But because I say the truth, ye believe me not.
